web_fixture.content:
# Bulk water tariff

Pellbrook Spring, effective 1 April 2026.

The bulk tariff is 89 pence per cubic metre, billed on the metered volume for
each calendar month. Standing charges do not apply on this tariff, and the
volume is read from the meter at the start and at the end of the month.

web_fixture.title: Bottling line tariff - Pellbrook Spring
web_fixture.snippet: Water drawn for the bottling line is charged at 41 pence per cubic metre, separately from the bulk tariff.
web_fixture.content:
# Bottling line tariff

Pellbrook Spring.

Water drawn for the bottling line is charged at 41 pence per cubic metre,
separately from the bulk tariff. The bottling line is metered on its own and the
two readings are never added together.

# Pellbrook Spring - bulk meter

Weekly meter readings for the bulk supply, in cubic metres. The four weeks cover
September. The charge that applies to this supply is set out on Pellbrook's own
tariff page.
